_notes: Named epic drops (docs/epic_drops_plan.md). WORLD: one 1-in-400 roll on any level 30+ kill, then one pick from the epics that fit the zone's level band. DUNGEON: a final boss's own epics (or the shared 30-39 pool) at the chance in final_bosses. PENDING: built, waiting on an icon of their own, and never dropped. Identity in tools/epic_table.py; stats from LootGenerator at epic budget, then put on the item curve. Rolled by entities/epic_drops.py.

world.name: Tidewidow's Wrap
world.flavor_text: Woven by the net-menders of Ratchet for the widows of drowned sailors.

world.name: Scavenger's Honest Grip
world.flavor_text: Work gloves from the Barrens salvage camps, reinforced at the fingertips.

world.name: Hollowmade Crown

world.name: Bluefinger
world.flavor_text: A Defias knife with a blued steel blade, lost when the Brotherhood scattered.

world.name: Rimeworn Pauldrons

world.name: Mirewalker's Hauberk

world.name: Penitent's Helm

world.name: The Lantern Bearer's Crossbow

world.name: Oathless

world.name: Hood of the Unseen Road

world.name: Gauntlets of the Iron Vow

world.name: Sablethorn Belt

world.name: Fisherman's Lucky Knot

world.name: Thunderhoof
world.flavor_text: A tauren war-mace with a head of bronze, blessed at the Freewind shrine.

world.name: Duskfang

world.name: Spire of Embers

world.name: Gutripper

world.name: Wardrake Greatbow

world.name: Idol of the Thornmother

world.name: Stonewake Greaves

world.name: The Second Opinion

world.name: The Understudy

world.name: The Standing Order

world.name: Threshing Day
world.flavor_text: A farmer's flail from the Hillsbrad fields, refitted with an iron head for war.

world.name: The Ledger of Debts

world.name: Vestments of the Grey Pilgrim
world.flavor_text: Grey travelling robes of the pilgrims who walk the King's Road to Uther's Tomb.

world.name: Wolfhide Jerkin
world.flavor_text: A jerkin of Alterac wolf hides, made by Frostwolf leatherworkers.

world.name: Coldforge Helm
world.flavor_text: A paladin's helm forged in Ironforge's coldest furnace, said to hold a blessing better.

world.name: Galecaller's Coif

world.name: Bracers of the Last Light
world.flavor_text: Bracers of the Silver Hand's healers, recovered from the ruins of Andorhal.

world.name: Thiefcatcher's Gloves
world.flavor_text: Gloves of the Steamwheedle bruisers, made to hold onto anyone they grab.

world.name: Cinch of Many Pockets
world.flavor_text: A tinker's work belt from Steamwheedle Port, hung with pouches for tools and parts.

world.name: Leggings of the Starless Night
world.flavor_text: Leggings woven by the Highborne in Eldre'Thalas from thread spun on moonless nights.

world.name: Mossback Treads
world.flavor_text: Soft boots of the Feralas druids, lined with moss gathered from the Twin Colossals.

world.name: Choker of the Drowned King
world.flavor_text: A naga noble's choker of black pearls, pulled from the wreck of a Kul Tiran warship.

world.name: Signet of the Ninth Legion
world.flavor_text: A Lordaeron officer's signet from the Ninth Legion, which held Hearthglen in the plague's first year.

world.name: Cape of the Wandering Blade

world.name: Headsman's Verdict

world.name: The Gentle Hand
world.flavor_text: A healer's mace from the Cathedral of Light, made to be carried more than swung.

world.name: Totem of the Rolling Thunder
world.flavor_text: A storm totem carved at Thunder Bluff before it fell, one of the few that were carried out.

world.name: Libram of the Steadfast Oath

world.name: Last Word on the Matter

world.name: Saltmother's Shawl

world.name: Three Winters' Boots
world.flavor_text: Fur-lined mail boots from Winterspring, resoled every spring for three years.

world.name: The Inventory

world.name: Quietkeep

world.name: The Long Watch

world.name: Rimefang

world.name: Bulwark of the Dead Sun

dungeon.name: Shardmaw's Underjaw
dungeon.flavor_text: The lower jaw of the crystal beast Shardmaw, set into a leather grip.

dungeon.name: Glassmaw's Gullet

dungeon.name: The Dry Well
dungeon.flavor_text: A ring of glittervein crystal taken from the bottom of the Cistern after the Thirst was killed.

dungeon.name: The Unmaking
dungeon.flavor_text: Thane Morrun's maul, which he swung against the walls of his own hall for a hundred years.

dungeon.name: The Unbanked Fire

dungeon.name: Serpent's Second Skin
